We’ve built real results here, and we know what this market responds to.

Houston Digital Marketing Services

We provide customized Houston digital marketing services built specifically for Houston businesses — every strategy is tailored to your market, your competition, and your growth goals.

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

Getting to page one of Google is one thing. Staying there is another one. Our proven SEO solutions work, starting with a proper audit—not a generic automated scan, but a real look at what’s holding your site back technically, where your competitors are beating you, and where the actual keyword opportunities are for a Houston business like yours. From there we handle everything: on-page fixes, link building, local SEO for the Google Maps pack, and content that earns rankings over time. It takes a few months to build real momentum, but once it’s there, it holds — and it compounds.

Web Design and Development

A lot of websites look fine and still don’t work—slow to load, frustrating on mobile, no clear path for a visitor to follow. That’s the kind of thing that kills conversions quietly in the background. We design every site we build around what we want visitors to do first, then around how it looks. We build on WordPress with Elementor with web developers and design  , which means you get something fast, easy to update yourself, and SEO-friendly out of the gate. No proprietary builders that lock you in. No handover headaches if you ever want to bring work in-house or change direction.

Social Media Marketing

Social media works when it’s built around a specific audience — not copied from a template. A strategy for a law firm looks nothing like one for a restaurant or a home services company, and it shouldn’t. We figure out which platforms your customers actually spend time on, what type of content gets real engagement in your industry, and how to turn that attention into leads your sales team can work with. Whether it’s organic content, paid social campaigns, or a mix of both, the goal is always the same: actual business outcomes, not just follower counts.

Pay-Per-Click (PPC)

PPC paid campaign can drain a budget fast if the setup is wrong. We’ve taken over plenty of Google Ads accounts that were spending heavily on the wrong keywords, sending clicks to pages that don’t convert, and reporting metrics that sounded good but had nothing to do with revenue. We fix the problems first, then build campaigns around what actually matters for your business. Our team manages Google, Meta, and display advertising for Houston clients at a range of budget levels — and we don’t dress up poor performance with vanity metrics to buy another month.

Online Reputation Management

Your Google reviews matter more than most business owners realize — they’re often what makes a potential customer pick you or keep scrolling. A run of bad reviews, even unfair ones, can quietly kill your lead flow for months. We handle reputation from both sides: making it easier for satisfied customers to leave reviews, and responding to negative ones in a way that actually helps your standing rather than making things worse. We also keep an eye on your brand across review platforms and directories so nothing falls through the cracks.

Content Marketing

Good content earns trust before the sale ever happens — and it does it while you sleep. We write blog posts, service pages, and guides that your potential customers actually want to read, not keyword-stuffed filler. Every piece is tied to a purpose: ranking for a specific search term, answering a question your customers ask over and over, or nudging someone closer to a buying decision. Our writers work alongside our SEO team, so the content isn’t just readable — it’s actively building your authority and organic visibility in Houston and beyond.

Video Production

Video is the format people actually stop and watch. A well-made explainer video, a genuine testimonial from a real client, or a look behind the scenes at your team can do more for trust-building than ten written pages. We handle the whole thing — scripting, filming, editing, and formatting for the platforms you’re using. If you’re running video ads on YouTube or social media marketing strategies, we can produce it with that distribution in mind from the start. Houston businesses that have leaned into video have seen real differences in how prospects respond before the first conversation even happens.

Conversion Rate Optimization

Getting traffic to your site is only half the job. If visitors aren’t turning into leads or customers, you’re paying for eyeballs and not much else. CRO is about understanding why people leave without acting — and fixing it. We look at heat maps, session recordings, form completion rates, and where people drop off in your funnel. Then we test changes: different page layouts, different headlines, different calls to action. The improvements tend to compound over time, which means the traffic you’re already getting starts working a lot harder without you spending more to get it.

Amazon Marketing Services

Amazon has its own search engine, its own ranking factors, and its own buyer psychology — and winning there takes a different approach than regular digital marketing. We help Houston-based sellers optimize their product listings and brand pages, improve visibility within Amazon’s search results, and run sponsored campaigns that bring in buyers rather than browsers. We also handle A+ content, brand store setup, and review strategy to make sure your products look trustworthy when a buyer is comparing you side by side with five competitors.

Why Houston Businesses Choose Zoot Web Agency?

We built Zoot around a simple idea: results matter. If clients don’t see growth, they leave. That mindset keeps our entire team accountable. While many agencies spend most of their time chasing new business, Zoot operates differently. As an internet marketing agency, our priority is retaining clients by delivering work that creates measurable impact. Every strategist, account manager, and specialist focuses on one thing: helping clients grow their business, not just presenting polished reports.

Honest, Straight Talk

We tell clients what we can realistically achieve, and we own it when something isn't performing the way we expected. If a strategy isn't working, we say so and change course — we don't hide it in a report. We've turned down clients who weren't a good fit and ended campaigns that weren't producing. That kind of honesty is sometimes uncomfortable, but it's the only way to build a working relationship that lasts.

Results We Can Show You

We have actual numbers from actual clients — traffic growth, lead increases, and revenue impact — across industries including legal, healthcare, home services, retail, and professional services. When we tell you something works, we can show you cases where it did. That track record shapes every recommendation we make because it filters out tactics that sound good in a pitch but don't move the needle in the real world.

Specialists, Not Generalists

Every person who works on your account is a specialist in their area. Your SEO isn't being handled by someone who also manages your social media and writes your blog posts on the side. We have dedicated people for each channel, and they actually talk to each other. That coordination matters — your campaigns reinforce each other instead of pulling in different directions.

Reporting That Makes Sense

Our monthly reports answer the questions that actually matter: what did we do, what did it produce, and what's the plan for next month? No 40-page PDFs packed with impressions and other metrics that don't connect to your bottom line. You also get access to your live dashboard anytime, plus a direct line to your account manager when you have a question between reports.

We Respect Your Time

We set timelines we intend to keep. Before any campaign or project kicks off, we walk through a realistic schedule so there are no surprises. When something runs longer than planned — and occasionally it does — we communicate early, explain what happened, and give you a revised date. You'll never be sitting there wondering why nothing has happened.

Built for Your Business

Generic packages don't work because no two businesses compete in the same way. Before we recommend anything, we do the homework — your market, your competitors, your current digital footprint, and where the actual growth opportunities are. What we put together for you is based on that research, not whatever package is easiest for us to sell this month.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions from Houston digital marketing services and what to expect when working with Zoot Web Agency.

How much does Houston digital marketing cost for a Houston business?

It varies depending on how competitive your category is and what channels you're prioritizing. Most Houston digital marketing services in the small-to-medium range spend somewhere between $1,500 and $5,000 per month for a full strategy. We do a free audit and put together a custom proposal before anything starts — so you'll know exactly what you're getting and what the realistic outcomes look like before you commit.

How long before I see results from SEO in Houston?

Three to six months is a reasonable window for most businesses to start seeing clear movement. Houston is a large market and some categories are more competitive than others — a niche B2B service will typically move faster than a general contractor in a crowded neighborhood. Paid ads are different and can produce leads from the first week. We're upfront about timelines and give you monthly reporting so you can track what's changing.

Do you have experience with Houston's energy industry?

Yes. We've worked with energy services companies, oilfield suppliers, and engineering firms on their digital marketing. B2B buying in energy tends to be longer and more research-heavy than consumer categories, which affects how we approach SEO, content, and LinkedIn specifically. We know how to position a company in this sector effectively online.

What makes Zoot different from other Houston digital marketing services?

Month-to-month contracts — no long-term lock-ins. A single dedicated account manager, not a rotating team. Reporting in plain language that tells you what your investment actually produced. We earn your business every month through results, which means we can't afford to coast.

Can you help my Houston business rank in Google Maps?

That's one of the specific things we focus on. We optimize your Google Business Profile, clean up local citations, build a steady flow of reviews, and handle the on-page local signals that influence Maps rankings. Most Houston clients start seeing meaningful movement in the local pack within 60 to 90 days.

Do you offer web design for Houston businesses?

Yes. Every site we build is on WordPress — fast, editable, and properly set up for SEO from launch. We don't prioritize looks over performance. On-page optimization, mobile speed, and clear conversion paths are built into every project as standard. Once the site is live, you own it completely and can manage it without needing us for routine updates.

Can you manage social media for my Houston business?

Yes. We handle content creation, posting, community management, and paid social ads across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn. Houston's diverse consumer base and strong B2B sector both respond well to consistent social presence — the strategy just looks different depending on whether you're selling to other businesses or directly to consumers. Everything we post is tied to a business goal, not just calendar-filling.

Do you work with Houston businesses that sell products online?

Yes. We work with eCommerce businesses on product page SEO, Google Shopping campaigns, Meta advertising, and email sequences that bring customers back. Houston's size creates a significant local and regional eCommerce opportunity that most businesses underutilize. We help you capture it with structured campaigns and properly optimized product listings.

How do you keep Houston clients informed about what's happening?

Monthly reporting is standard for every client. You get a clear breakdown of what we did, what changed, and what it means for your business — in plain English, not marketing shorthand. Beyond reports, you have direct access to your account manager. We don't make you go through a support ticket to ask a basic question about your campaign.

What happens when I first reach out to Zoot?

We start with a free audit of your digital presence — your website, search rankings, Google Business Profile, and any ad accounts you're running. We look at what's working, what isn't, and where the biggest opportunities are for a Houston business in your category. Then we put together a clear proposal showing the work, the expected outcomes, and the cost. No obligation to move forward — the audit alone is useful.
